subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Packaging Reduction
description: A quick win: understand Packaging Reduction.

hook.text: A tiny USB drive arrives in a box 20 times its size, wrapped in plastic, inside another box. Absurd.

buildup.text: Packaging waste accounts for 30% of all municipal solid waste. Most of it comes from supply chain shipping.

discovery.text: Right-sizing boxes, eliminating plastic, and using recyclable materials cut waste and shipping costs.

twist.text: Reducing packaging too aggressively risks product damage. More returns from breakage can offset the savings.

climax.text: Amazon's frustration-free packaging program has eliminated over 2 million tons of packaging material.

punchline.text: Less packaging, less waste, lower cost. Simple math.

quiz.question: What share of municipal solid waste does packaging account for?
